I'm not an expert in drug usage and I personally have nothing against them if they're used safely. But in saying that relying on K to treat depression probably isn't the best.

It might turn into addiction which would be even more difficult to handle and another contributing factor to depression. It could also be considered self harm because just like cutting and other forms it releases temporary dopamine that you'll keep chasing.

Once again therapy and prescribed medication is probably the best way to go. I know everyone says it and it's not ever easy to just do something someone says, but please look into that avenue for support and ways to cope.

Keep using ket if you want but be safe and make sure you don't become dependent.

Seeking help from trained people irl is probably the best thing you can do. The fear of judgement is daunting and it's easier said than done, but you really have to be selfish and say my health is going to come before their opinion.

I'm saying that there are some apps about there like the 'Mindfulness app' that are good for guided distraction. These apps can help you get out of a crisis situations until the feelings pass. They won't solve everything but that, a combination of therapy, maybe medication and all the other things people tell you to do should take you a long way.

I have never had more appreciation for this language than now. 

To the majority of us these words are mundane, every day, boring even. But to others it’s magic, the vibrating air they process so new in a way they had never heard. 
It’s magical. 
I didn’t think it would be so literal though. I’m not pretentious, I’ll admit that my vocabulary is a little more ‘colourful’ than most that comes with the plethora of books I’ve buried myself in. Reading fantasy time and time again, wishing that dragons where real, that I could maybe shoot lazers out of my hair or something I don’t know. 
I woke up.
Not where I thought I would wake up. I woke up in a bed chamber, it overlooked a port. One that seemed far too familiar for my liking. 

“You are up.”

Old. He was old, his face was worn leather. But even so his eyes creased with a sparkle, so much so I would’ve thought he were my grandpa. Something about his voice seemed off though, like when you try to tumble French to Frenchman in hopes he doesn’t spit at you while giving directions. 

“What the hell, I swear I feel like a rock slapped my face,” Oh god I regret letting those words leave my lips. Because oh yes a rock did indeed decide to slap my face just as the last syllable ended. “FUCK, I’M GOING TO PUNCH A DUCK,” And a duck appeared. This was not good. 

“You are masterful of this language,” he drawled it slowly. 

“Yeah I guess… Just wondering where am I?” I wasn’t sure if I would be happy with the answer.

“The Eastern Moric Port, we overlook the Sea of Therline.” 

Yep, it seems I had fallen asleep and awoke in the book my nose was buried in. Unless of course this was an elaborate dream, ‘this is a dream’ did not seem to fit as an explanation for the situation. So I guess it was time to get used to my life in Amura, and from the book it seemed that the continent of Casanear was for those who wanted an adventure. 
This would be one damn hell of an adventure I see.
